subject: Proposed 45m Redwood demo + exec Q&A — VP/CTO availability & fallback
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <pshah@clearwave.com>, Ethan Walker <ewalker@clearwave.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposed 45m Redwood demo + exec Q&A — VP/CTO availability & fallback

Hi Priya / Ethan,

Thanks again for the time last week — excited to show a targeted demo for the search-and-assist workflow you described. To make the session most valuable, we'd like a 45-minute slot (30m demo + 15m exec Q&A) and to confirm whether your CTO and VP of Product can join for the Q&A.

Two windows that work for our team next week (PT):
- Tue Nov 16, 10:00–10:45am PT
- Wed Nov 17, 2:30–3:15pm PT

If both execs can attend, great — if not, no problem. We propose a contingency: we hold the primary slot but have a short backup slot the same day or a delegate run in case an exec needs to hop off. I attached a 1-page mutual action plan and the deck we plan to walk through.

Logistics notes:
- Dry run with your technical lead (15m) the morning of the demo to confirm SSO and network paths.
- We'll record the session and share the recording & appendix for compliance.

Can you confirm which window is easiest for the CTO and VP? Also flag any specific compliance/security questions (e.g., data retention, isolation) you want us to cover so Ben can prepare the right artifacts.

Thanks,

Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx, redwood-demo-deck_v2.pdf
From: Priya Shah <pshah@clearwave.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Ethan Walker <ewalker@clearwave.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposed 45m Redwood demo + exec Q&A — VP/CTO availability & fallback

Hi Grace — thanks for the options and the materials.

Quick update on our side:
- CTO (Ethan) can make Wed Nov 17, 2:30pm PT, but he is booked for Tue the 16th.
- VP Product (Meera Patel) asked if we can look at an afternoon slot on Tue Nov 16 (after 3pm PT) or the Wed Nov 17 slot you noted. She may be traveling Tue morning and couldn't commit until tomorrow.

If the CTO is only available Wed and VP availability is uncertain, we'd like to confirm a fallback plan so we don't lose momentum. Two asks:
1) Can you hold Wed 2:30pm PT as the primary?
2) If VP can't make it, can Redwood run the demo + CTO Q&A and then schedule a short follow-up with our VP (15–20m) to cover product/roadmap questions?

Also our security team will want the recording and the list of artifacts you mentioned (SOC2 scope and data retention statement). Ben, can you confirm you'll bring those?

Best,

Priya Shah
Head of Strategic Partnerships | ClearWave
pshah@clearwave.com
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Proposed 45m Redwood demo + exec Q&A — VP/CTO availability & fallback

Thanks — that approach works. To make the contingency explicit, here's the proposed orchestration (we'll share as an updated MAP):

Primary slot (hold): Wed Nov 17, 2:30–3:15pm PT — demo + CTO Q&A (Ethan confirmed).
Fallback options:
- Short follow-up for VP Product (Meera): 15–20m follow-up within 72 hours — we'll schedule once Meera confirms availability.
- Day-of delegate: if VP needs to depart, Ben will run product-focused questions and capture action items for Meera.

Day-of ops:
- Dry run w/ ClearWave technical lead: Wed Nov 17, 11:00am PT (15m) — Ben, can you own the dry run and SSO check?
- Recording & artifacts: we'll record the primary session; Ben will upload SOC2 scope excerpt + retention summary to the SharePoint link and send to Priya by EOD Wed.
- HubSpot: I'll update the deal CW-4982 with the finalized MAP + call notes and link the recording.

Ben, Vivek — are you OK with the delegate plan and the timeline above? Priya/Ethan — if this still meets your needs, we'll send a calendar invite for Wed and a short follow-up placeholder for Meera (tentative).

On Wed we plan to demo: low-latency retrieval, routing policies for private deployments, and a quick cost/latency tradeoff section tailored to your footprint.

Regards,

Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
